moments.title: Bonfire Night Weekend Continues
moments.blurb: While Bonfire Night officially passed yesterday, fireworks displays and celebrations are continuing across the UK throughout the weekend, with events in Surrey and the West Midlands still to come.

source.l: Time Out London / Weston Park / Surrey Live

angles.name: weekend firework fun
angles.copy: Still got that gunpowder smell in the air? Bonfire Night celebrations are rolling on all weekend across the UK with dazzling displays. Where's your favourite spot to catch the action?

angles.name: post-bonfire buzz
angles.copy: From backyard sparklers to epic organised displays, Bonfire Night 2026 might officially be over, but the firework fun isn't! Many events are lighting up the skies through Sunday.

angles.name: Songs In The Key Of Life 50
